messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — Atlaswell's QA just reported 429s hitting their EU demo env. They go live Thu 2026-05-14 14:00-17:00 UTC. They asked if we can temporarily increase throughput and add their proxy CIDRs to an allowlist. Renewal check in 10 days; need to avoid demo flake.
Atlaswell Ops (customer): Confirming our egress IPs: 192.0.2.16/28 and 198.51.100.128/29. We expect a burst to ~2.5x baseline during the 3h window. We can throttle client-side if you need to cap.
Ren (Edge Eng): Thanks. Are they using the hosted gateway (eu-central) or our regional proxy? Which endpoints — streaming text or embeddings?
Maya (CSM): Hosted API via eu-central proxy, primarily streaming text completions for the demo. They're not on Dedicated.
Theo (SRE): Short checklist: 1) temp QPS bump scoped to window, 2) route ACL for two CIDRs, 3) auto-revoke after 5h, 4) monitoring alarm for queue depth and 5xx rate. Any objections?
Maya (CSM): No objections. Auto-revoke 5h is fine. Please keep rollback button obvious. I'll notify customer that it's time-bound.
Ren (Edge Eng): I'll prepare the ACL and traffic override. Change to apply 10m before start. Config I'll stage:
```
target: eu-central-1
allowlist:
  - 192.0.2.16/28
  - 198.51.100.128/29
throughput_override: 2.5x
apply_window: 2026-05-14T14:00:00Z/2026-05-14T17:00:00Z
auto_revoke: 5h
```
Ren (Edge Eng): ETA ~25m to stage and validate in staging cluster.
OpsBot: Ticket created CS-11097 (owner: Ren) — Atlaswell temp EU allowlist + QPS lift. Scheduled: 2026-05-14 14:00-17:00 UTC. Auto-revoke: 5h.
Theo (SRE): I'll run a quick capacity simulation for eu-central pool and set a fallback to eu-fallback-1 if latency > 120ms observed. Also adding an alert: route_queue > 60% or 5xx > 0.5% triggers page.
Maya (CSM): Atlaswell, do you have a contact who will watch the demo so we can coordinate rollbacks if needed?
Atlaswell Ops (customer): Yes — Sarah (oncall) will be on standby and reachable at sarah@atlaswell.io. We'll also enable client-side exponential backoff.
Ren (Edge Eng): Staged the ACL and override in staging, ran traffic validation (10k requests/min sim) — latency remained under SLO and no cross-tenant contamination seen. I'll tag the change for production apply.
Theo (SRE): Capacity looks good for a 2.5x uplift with fallback. I've set the monitoring and a temporary runbook entry to guide on rollback steps.
Maya (CSM): Great. I'll update the renewal notes: outcome of the demo will impact short-term renewal sentiment; CS delivered ops support which should mitigate risk. I'll also send the runbook to Sarah and the CSM renewal owner.
Ren (Edge Eng): Applying change 10m before window. Will post once applied.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: apply CS-11097 at 2026-05-14T13:50:00Z.
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone. Post-demo, please add a short feedback bullet: perceived latency, any 429s, and whether they need a sustained SOW for capacity. I'll collect customer feedback and open a follow-up if Atlaswell wants Dedicated or Reserved capacity. :thumbsup:
Atlaswell Ops (customer): Thanks team. We'll report back after the demo.
Ren (Edge Eng): Applied and validated in prod. Allowlist active; throughput override in place. Monitoring green.
Theo (SRE): Watching metrics. No abnormal spikes so far. Alert thresholds armed.
Maya (CSM): Closing loop for pre-demo ops. Will post an after-action thread with customer notes and next steps after the demo.
